item.title: Sovereign Driver — the whole album, sung and explained
item.description:
Sovereign Driver played end to end — Tool-heavy prog and baroque hard rock — with an extended spoken introduction before every song, tracing the album's descent and return: from the aseity of God, through providence and the eternal decree, down to the incarnation, and up to the throne of the slain Lamb. Eight tracks, eight intros, one continuous listen — the Sovereign Driver who becomes the Sovereign Diver.

item.title: Roots of Reason — the whole album, sung and explained
item.description:
Roots of Reason played end to end — Reformed theology set to roots reggae — with a short spoken intro before every song. Cruciform power before Pilate, the two Adams and true dominion, Isaiah's thrice-holy vision, the Euthyphro dilemma, Plato's cave as the new birth, suffering under God's sovereignty, the apostles' hard road, the cage of autonomy, worship as warfare, the bodily resurrection, the empty tomb of Matthew 28, and the nations streaming in.

item.title: John & Them — the whole album, sung and explained
item.description:
John & Them played end to end — street-gospel hip-hop through the eyes of the apostle John and his neighbors — with a short spoken intro before every song. Abiding in light and love, the finished gospel, Chesterton's fence and chronological snobbery, the assurance of the new birth, the rich young ruler, Jude against the false teachers, the antichrist spirit of 'Christ plus,' the bread handed to Judas, the prodigal's one road home, and the Creator born of the creature.

item.title: Common Grace — the whole album, sung and explained
item.description:
Common Grace played end to end — a warm, genre-hopping ode to the everyday kindness God pours on the whole human race — with a short spoken intro before every song. Sun on the sinner, Kuyper's every-square-inch, Ecclesiastes' vapor and the love that makes an unchanging town new, marriage as gift, the goodness of matter, thanksgiving on an ordinary day, the cure for the curved-in self, Lady Wisdom's clap-back, and the Transfiguration by way of the cross.

item.title: Barn Dance — the whole album, sung and explained
item.description:
Barn Dance played end to end — Scripture and old hymns kicked up into a warm, string-lit hoedown — with a short spoken intro before every song telling you the Scripture and the story underneath it. Isaiah's courtroom grace, the peace that tore down the dividing wall, a metrical Psalm 23, Reginald Heber's martyr-hymn, Horatius Bonar's threefold invitation, and Psalm 1's tree by the water.
